about: A Rust library for making and opening 7z archives.

prs.title: Unpacked files keep their permissions
prs.broken: Files unpacked from a 7z archive lost their permissions, so scripts and programs could no longer be run.
prs.changed: On Linux and macOS, files are now created with the permissions saved in the archive.
prs.matters: Programs and scripts work straight out of the archive, like with the 7z tool.

prs.title: Shortcut links in a folder are packed, not dropped
prs.broken: Packing a folder into a 7z archive quietly skipped any links inside it, so those files and folders were missing from the archive with no error.
prs.changed: Links are now followed: a link to a file stores the file, a link to a folder stores the folder, as the 7z tool does.
prs.matters: Archives hold everything the folder showed, so nothing goes missing on unpacking.
